game_concept: A tower defense set in Sand Dunes – Mirage Road, a road of shimmering mirages: the scarab scholar must handle desert bandits while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Integration Heist: Combine loops, conditionals, and lists to complete a multi-step script that raids Mirage Road.
theme: Sand Dunes – Mirage Road: a road of shimmering mirages
core_gameplay_loop: In Mirage Road, repeat each round: Combine loops, conditionals, and lists to complete a multi-step script that raids Mirage Road. Each round, desert bandits strike the caravan wagon, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the heist value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the caravan wagon from desert bandits in Mirage Road: keep the heist meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 46-second timer ends.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: heist drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 46-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 2 (intro tier): Integration Heist
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Integration Heist' (Week 9 slot 7), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Mirage Road'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how heist changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against desert bandits in Mirage Road.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 46 seconds while heist > 0.
